Is the country ready for that push to electric vehicles and how do you balance transportation for the next generation?

Well, you know, I often point out to my colleagues that and the administration now without E85, for example, California wouldn't be meeting its carbon emission reduction goals. It is fantastic that We want to move to a larger percentage of the population of consumers to electric vehicles. That's great. But that is not going to happen overnight. And the point I've made to some of my colleagues is, you know, it actually is not that progressive because, you know, not everybody is going to be able to afford an electric vehicle in the next 10 years. And so they're Again, needs to be a period of time where we are transitioning and, you know, renewable fuels are just such a great alternative.
